release_notes:
Full in-app installer fix with Android package installation permissions and hold-to-2x player upgrades.

Added
- In-app package installer permissions (REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES) for seamless direct updating without opening browser
- Non-blocking system installer process launcher to ensure download and install never hangs at 100%
- Web player hold click for 2x playback speed

Changed
- Updated in-app download progress indicator to show 'Starting installer…' at completion

Fixed
- Resolved 100% download hang when installing app updates on Android
- Fixed Android PackageInstaller intent timeouts
